decks.name: John Henry
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set stars-stripes. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: John Henry
hero.specialAbility:
STEEL-DRIVING MAN
You have 10 track tokens.
At the start of your turn, summon a track token in a space in John Henry's zone.
When you move John Henry, do not count spaces with track tokens.
hero.quote: A man ain't nothin' but a man.

cards.title: Twelve-Pound Hammer
cards.afterText: If John Henry used at least 4 different paths this turn, you may place a fighter in the combat in any space with a track token.

cards.title: Deeds of Valor
cards.duringText: John Henry cannot take more than 2 combat damage this combat.

cards.title: Eighteen-Pound Hammer
cards.immediateText: If John Henry used at least 4 different paths this turn, cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Power Through
cards.afterText: Move a fighter in the combat up to 2 spaces. Do not count spaces with track tokens.

cards.title: Knock Them Silly
cards.immediateText: If you win this combat, cancel all AFTER COMBAT effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Striking Fire
cards.basicText:
Move John Henry up to 4 spaces.
Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Cool Drink of Water
cards.afterText: John Henry recovers 3 health. Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Nine-Pound Hammer
cards.afterText: If John Henry used at least 4 different paths this turn, deal 2 damage to each opposing fighter in his zone.

cards.title: Hear That Cold Steel Ring
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card. Move John Henry up to 1 space. Gain 1 free action to attack.

cards.title: Bring Down the Mountain
cards.duringText: Add +1 to this card's value for each HAMMER card in your discard pile.

cards.title: Momentous Shift
cards.duringText: If John Henry started this turn in a different space, this card's value becomes 5.

decks.name: Rosie the Riveter
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set stars-stripes. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Rosie the Riveter
hero.specialAbility:
FREEDOM XK-II MECH SUIT
You have 4 upgrade tokens. Start the game with all 4 inactive.
At the start of your turn, activate an upgrade.
At the end of your turn, if all 4 upgrades are active, deactivate all of them.

cards.title: D-Day
cards.afterText: Gain 1 free action to attack. Activate all of your upgrades. If they were already active, deal 1 damage to the opposing fighter and Rosie recovers 1 health.

cards.title: Full Metal
cards.duringText: Add +1 to this card's value for each active upgrade.

cards.title: Momentous Shift
cards.duringText: If your fighter started this turn in a different space, this card's value becomes 5.

cards.title: Rapid Development
cards.basicText:
Draw 2 cards.
Activate or deactivate an upgrade.
Gain 1 free action to attack.

cards.title: Technological Superiority
cards.immediateText: If you have 3 or more active upgrades, cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Arc Welding
cards.afterText:
Choose one:
► activate an upgrade
► deal 1 damage to each adjacent opposing fighter

cards.title: Hasty Repairs
cards.afterText: If you have any active upgrades, deactivate one, and Rosie recovers 3 health.

cards.title: Overrun
cards.afterText: Move Rosie up to 3 spaces. She may move through opposing fighters. Then, deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter she moved through.

cards.title: "E" Award
cards.basicText:
Activate or deactivate an upgrade.
Move each of your fighters up to 3 spaces.

cards.title: Loose Lips Sink Ships!
cards.duringText: Your opponent reveals the top card of their deck. Decrease the value of their card by the revealed card's BOOST value.

ruleCards.title: Upgrades
ruleCards.content:
Cavity Magnetron: After Rosie attacks, you may draw 1 card.
Merlin Engine: When you maneuver, Rosie may move 1 additional space.
Sedgley Fist Gun: Add +1 to the value of Rosie's attacks.
Whizbang: Rosie is a ranged hero.
(Each works only while its token is on the active face.)

decks.name: George Washington
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set stars-stripes. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: George Washington
hero.specialAbility:
ESPIONAGE
You start with 4 ruse tokens.
When you attack, you may use a ruse token, placing it next to the card. Before your opponent chooses whether or not to defend, they may discard 1 random card to remove the ruse token.
(Effects marked RUSE only work if the ruse token is still next to the card.)

cards.title: Allies Everywhere
cards.afterText: Gain 1 free action to attack.

cards.title: Circumvent
cards.duringText: RUSE: Ignore the value of your opponent's card.

cards.title: Feint
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Make a Stand
cards.duringText: If your fighter started this turn in their current space, this card's value becomes 5.

cards.title: Misinformation
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, regain a ruse token.

cards.title: Network of Spies
cards.duringText: Add +1 to this card's value for each other friendly fighter in Washington's zone.

cards.title: Sympathetic Stain
cards.basicText:
Choose an opponent and look at their hand.
If a Spy is adjacent to one of their fighters, choose a card for them to discard and regain a ruse token.

cards.title: Undercover Agent
cards.duringText: Washington may swap spaces with an adjacent Spy. If he does, that Spy is now the defender.

cards.title: Recruit to the Ring
cards.afterText: Return a defeated Spy to a space adjacent to Washington. If you won the combat, return that Spy to any space instead.

cards.title: Lead Astray
cards.afterText: Move a fighter in the combat up to 2 spaces.

cards.title: Gather Information
cards.basicText:
Draw 3 cards.
Move each of your fighters up to 3 spaces. They may move through opposing fighters.

cards.title: Agent 711
cards.afterText: RUSE: If you won the combat, deal 7 damage to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Sabotage
cards.afterText: RUSE: If you won the combat, your opponent discards 2 random cards.

decks.name: Wyatt Earp
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set stars-stripes. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Wyatt Earp
hero.specialAbility:
SHOWDOWN
After you attack and win combat, choose one effect. You cannot choose the same effect twice in a turn.
► draw 1 card
► gain 1 free action to attack
► move your fighter up to 1 space

cards.title: A Marshal and an Outlaw
cards.afterText:
If you played this card to defend, draw 1 card.
If you played this card to attack, your opponent discards 1 card.

cards.title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to any fighter. Your opponent deals 1 damage to any fighter. Deal 1 damage to any fighter. Your opponent deals 1 damage to any fighter.

cards.title: I'm Your Huckleberry
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, deal 1 damage to an opposing fighter in your fighter's zone.

cards.title: In Vino Veritas
cards.basicText: Draw until you have 4 cards in your hand. Gain 1 free action to attack.

cards.title: I Have Two Guns, One for Each of You
cards.afterText: If your opponent played a card, deal damage equal to that card's printed value to a different opposing fighter in Doc Holliday's zone.

cards.title: Bring 'Em to Justice
cards.duringText: Reveal the top card of your opponent's deck. Increase the value of this card by twice that card's BOOST value.

cards.title: Fan the Hammer
cards.afterText: If the opposing fighter was defeated, return this card to your hand.

cards.title: You Die First
cards.basicText: Move an opposing fighter up to 1 space. Gain 1 free action to attack that fighter.

cards.title: Better Swear Me In
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.afterText: Reveal the top card of your opponent's deck. You may put it on the bottom of their deck.

cards.title: You're a Daisy If You Do
cards.afterText: Draw 2 cards.

cards.title: You Just Gonna Stand There and Bleed?
